name: Sirius Romanée-Conti
japaneseName: シリウス・ロマネコンティ
description: Sirius Romanée-Conti is the Sin Archbishop of Wrath in the Witch Cult. Bound in bandages and proclaiming herself to be Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti's wife, she adheres to an obsessive philosophy of shared emotion and sensory unity. She served as one of the primary antagonists during the siege of Priestella in Arc 5 before being defeated and captured.
